meta.name: trojan_horse_in_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: The legendary colossal wooden Trojan horse carpentered from weathered ship timbers and oak planks on a heavy wheeled timber chassis, with a concealed trapdoor belly holding Greek soldiers in silence waiting to emerge.

tokens.terrain: a walled bronze-age citadel city on a rise overlooking the coastal plain and the Aegean shore
tokens.icons: the monumental wooden Trojan horse brought inside the Skaian gates or set in the city plaza; towering stone circuit walls and watchtowers; royal citadel megaron overlooking flat-roofed quarters; deserted Greek camp trenches outside the walls; Greek warships concealed offshore
tokens.event_direction: Greek soldiers hiding inside the belly of the colossal wooden horse situated within the city walls, poised to emerge at nightfall
